key_idea: Build the game backwards from the tenth frame: a frame's score depends only on the next two rolls, so DFS over (used mask, next two rolls, score) with memoisation enumerates all reachable totals.
sketch: Try each frame as the tenth (an open frame only if the third roll is 0); its score is its two rolls plus the third. Then prepend frames one at a time: a strike adds 10+next two rolls and becomes a single roll, a spare adds 10+next roll, an open frame adds its pins; frames of the form '10 x' with x>0 can only be the tenth. Memoise on (mask, n1, n2, score) as a bitset, at most 1024*121*320 states. Output 'S Yes' or S followed by the nearest lower and higher reachable totals when they exist. The no-match output format is not shown in any sample, so the space-separated form is a guess; only the Yes path was confirmed by samples.
